findings.passage: “Citizen-run elections are an essential element of self-governance,” Rep. Shaw Blackmon, R-Bonaire, the bill’s sponsor, told the House Governmental Affairs Committee on Friday. “Our ballot casting is meant to be in secret, but the counting is not.”
findings.note: Quoted by the AJC in committee on his bill HB 426, which would open paper ballots to public inspection after certification. Not about ID or citizenship; saved as an election-integrity law in general.
AJC names him as sponsor of HB 426, which would give the public access to paper ballots after an election is certified. Committee approved it 2023-03-03. Not about ID or citizenship.
